CHF.note: STANDING CONTEXT, NOT A MONDAY CATALYST (article dated 8 Oct, four days before this session): the franc is 'remaining under pressure from short positions amid expectations of further monetary tightening across other major economies', with the SNB holding at 0% while others tighten, so 'interest-rate differentials with other major economies widen' and Swiss borrowing costs stay 'the world's lowest' - which keeps CHF a funding currency for carry. No source dated 12 Oct explains Monday specifically.

USD.note: STANDING CONTEXT, NOT A MONDAY CATALYST (dated 8 Oct): Fed minutes showed most policymakers see another rate hike by year-end and US inflation expectations hit their highest since May 2023, taking the dollar index up 0.42% to 102.27.
